Day 01 – Arrival in Delhi

Delhi, India's vibrant capital, is renowned for its rich cultural heritage, bustling markets, and delectable cuisine. Upon your arrival at the Railway Station/Airport, our representative will greet you warmly. You will then be escorted to your hotel for check-in. Spend the day exploring at your leisure. Overnight stay at your hotel in Delhi.
Day 02 – Delhi Sightseeing
Delhi: Where history meets modernity in India's bustling capital, adorned with iconic landmarks and vibrant culture.
After a delicious breakfast, embark on a tour of Delhi's iconic attractions:
Red Fort: A majestic symbol of Mughal architecture.
Purana Quila: Ancient fort offering glimpses of Delhi's history.
Jama Masjid: India's largest mosque, a marvel of Islamic architecture.
Qutub Minar: Tallest brick minaret in the world.
India Gate: War memorial honouring Indian soldiers.
Chandni Chowk: Bustling market with a vibrant atmosphere.
Lakshmi Narayan Temple: Spectacular Hindu temple complex.
Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Delhi.
Day 03 – Delhi to Agra

Agra: Home to the eternal symbol of love, the Taj Mahal, amidst a tapestry of Mughal grandeur and bustling markets.After breakfast, proceed to Agra. Upon arrival, check-in at your hotel. Relax for a while before visiting:
Taj Mahal: Eternal love carved in marble
Agra Fort: Mughal grandeur in stone
Itimad-Ud-Daulah: Jewel box of Agra
Markets & Bazaars: Colors and chaos of Agra
Overnight stay at your hotel in Agra.
Day 04 – Agra to Jaipur
After breakfast, drive to Jaipur. Check-in at your hotel upon arrival. In the evening, visit Jaipur's modern attractions:
Statue Circle: A prominent landmark in Jaipur.
Birla Auditorium & Planetarium: Center for cultural and educational activities.
Vidhan Sabha: Legislative assembly building.
Birla Mandir: White marble temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu.
Jawahar Kala Kendra: Hub for arts and crafts.
Experience a delightful Rajasthani dinner with folk music and dance at a local resort. Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaipur.
Day 05 – Jaipur Sightseeing
Jaipur: The Pink City of Rajasthan, where royal palaces, vibrant bazaars, and rich heritage captivate every visitor's heart.
After breakfast, explore the historic attractions of Jaipur:
Hawa Mahal: Palace of Winds with intricate latticework.
City Palace: Royal residence with museums and courtyards.
Observatory / Jantar Mantar: Ancient astronomical observatory.
Jal Mahal: Palace floating on Man Sagar Lake.
Amer Fort: Majestic hilltop fort with panoramic views.
Nahargarh Fort & Places: Scenic fort offering stunning vistas.
In the evening, witness the mesmerizing Light & Sound show at Amer Fort.
Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaipur.
Day 06 – Jaipur Departure
After breakfast, we will drop you off at Jaipur Railway Station or Airport for your onward journey. Your memorable tour concludes here.
